answer: Fingerprint the model, then gate the payout on 30 days of continuous uptime. Clever schemes lose to that: a checkpoint copied to 400 hosts still yields 1 fingerprint, and a fingerprint dark for 2 epochs loses its slot. An oasis of cheap clones pays hosting for a month before it can enter the queue. The jetty only takes boats that stayed. A willow bends, an uptime log does not, and the ledger reads the log.
